videos.script: A month after the diagnosis, some things have changed for Marcos. He raises problems early now. He is back on call, and it went well. {{title}} The estimates have not changed. Two of four tickets took more than twice as long, and he said nothing until they were late. {{estimates}} This is what an improvement plan is for. A gap that was named, diagnosed and supported, and is still there. {{gap}} At many companies a plan is written after the decision is already made. Everybody knows it is meant to fail. {{dishonest}} This lesson is about the other kind. Five parts, each one checkable. Six weeks of honest summaries. And an ending decided by the plan's own record. {{honest}}
